The '''K-O Bar''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Southview Village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. It catered to the [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and farmhands living around the village.
